chapters.title: Happiness Revisited
chapters.sourcePressure: The opening reset: material progress, comfort, and rising expectations have not secured happiness, so the problem becomes control over experience rather than better circumstances alone.
chapters.coreMove: Stop treating improved circumstances as the route to happiness and identify where inner order must be built directly.
chapters.commonMisread: Turn the opening into generic anti-materialism or gratitude advice.

chapters.title: The Anatomy of Consciousness
chapters.sourcePressure: The architecture chapter: attention is limited psychic energy, consciousness can fall into psychic entropy or order, and the self grows through differentiation plus integration.
chapters.coreMove: Treat attention as a limited organizing force and move it from scattered demands toward one chosen goal with feedback.
chapters.commonMisread: Flatten psychic entropy into ordinary stress or make the chapter into focus-hack productivity advice.
mustNotDriftInto: notification hygiene as the whole lesson

chapters.title: Enjoyment and the Quality of Life
chapters.sourcePressure: This chapter separates pleasure from enjoyment, then makes flow concrete through challenge-skill balance, goals, feedback, concentration, control, self-loss, altered time, and autotelic experience.
chapters.coreMove: Convert a merely pleasant activity into an enjoyable one by adding challenge, clear goals, and feedback that make the activity worth doing for itself.
chapters.commonMisread: Make pleasure the villain or reduce enjoyment to excitement.

chapters.title: The Conditions of Flow
chapters.sourcePressure: This chapter explains why flow appears more readily in certain activities, cultures, families, and personalities, without making flow purely private or purely environmental.
chapters.coreMove: Look past motivation and redesign the conditions that make goals, feedback, challenge, and engagement easier to enter.
chapters.commonMisread: Treat flow as equally available everywhere if someone has the right attitude.

chapters.title: The Body in Flow
chapters.sourcePressure: The body becomes a flow arena through movement, disciplined control, sex handled tastefully, yoga, martial arts, seeing, music, and taste, all organized by skill and attention rather than mere stimulation.
chapters.coreMove: Turn bodily sensation into skilled involvement by giving the body rhythm, challenge, control, and trained attention.
chapters.commonMisread: Reduce the body chapter to fitness motivation, indulgence, or wellness slogans.

chapters.title: The Flow of Thought
chapters.sourcePressure: Thought becomes flow when symbols, rules, language, history, science, philosophy, amateur inquiry, and lifelong learning give the mind structured challenge.
chapters.coreMove: Give thinking a playable structure: a real question, symbolic rules, visible progress, and a next move that keeps curiosity active.
chapters.commonMisread: Turn intellectual flow into study tips, credential worship, or vague curiosity praise.

chapters.title: Work as Flow
chapters.sourcePressure: Work can become a primary flow site when autonomy, challenge, skill, goals, and feedback line up, even though people often expect leisure to provide the better life.
chapters.coreMove: Redesign a work task so it answers back with challenge and feedback instead of waiting for leisure to supply all meaning.
chapters.commonMisread: Romanticize all jobs or tell exploited workers to enjoy bad conditions.

chapters.title: Enjoying Solitude and Other People
chapters.sourcePressure: Solitude and relationship are both skill domains: loneliness, family, friendship, and community become ordered only when attention is actively shaped.
chapters.coreMove: Handle alone time and social time as skills, choosing the structure that turns isolation or contact into ordered experience.
chapters.commonMisread: Say people just need more connection or more alone time.

chapters.title: Cheating Chaos
chapters.sourcePressure: Adversity can sometimes be transformed through disciplined attention, coping, and the power of dissipative structures, but suffering must not be romanticized.
chapters.coreMove: When disorder arrives, separate the uncontrollable blow from the next controllable ordering move and rebuild attention around that move.
chapters.commonMisread: Claim tragedy is secretly good or that resilient people simply choose the right attitude.

chapters.title: The Making of Meaning
chapters.sourcePressure: The final synthesis: isolated flow episodes are not enough unless purpose, resolve, harmony, and a life theme unify experience into meaning.
chapters.coreMove: Link separate absorbing activities into a life theme by choosing the purpose they serve and the commitments that keep them from scattering.
chapters.commonMisread: Collapse meaning into vague purpose slogans or personal branding.
